caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a figure entirely wrapped in a flowing, pale-colored cloth that drapes down and pools at the base. The head of the figure appears round and is covered with the same material, which is tied or gathered at the neck. The face is stylized with thick, black, horizontal eyebrows, solid black oval eyes, and a black mouth, all set against a light background face. There is a section of the cloth extending from the neck region over the right shoulder as if part of the garment is loosely hanging. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and there are no additional objects or details present. The overall color palette consists of muted beige and cream for the fabric, with stark black facial features. The artist’s name is written in small print towards the lower right.
title: Ghost of Judy
